description: This file defines the AccountAssociationsRepository interface, which extends Spring Data JPA repository interfaces to provide CRUD operations and custom queries for AccountAssociations entities, specifically for fetching associations based on loan or savings account IDs and association type.

classes.name: AccountAssociationsRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for managing AccountAssociations entities with custom query methods.

methods.name: findByLoanIdAndType
methods.description: Finds an AccountAssociations record by associated loan account ID and association type.

methods.name: findBySavingsIdAndType
methods.description: Finds an AccountAssociations record by associated savings account ID and association type.
